title: Collectors and records Brown made
summary: Brown gets no money from the records but collectors abroad want them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Are there any other records that you've made that you wanted to mention as outstanding for people to hear?
Well, they don't do me any good. I got paid for the, I got paid for the side.
I just thought you might want people to hear.

I do know that there's a lot of record collectors that are after the records. They've wrote me and asked me if I'd ever know when they're going to release some more of them. And I'd like to get some, I've had different musicians from Australia, some from England and France. They wanted to get other copies of it. Asked me if there's any releases coming. I don't know anything about it. In fact, it doesn't mean anything to me. There's no money in my pocket. And I told them I don't know just when they're releasing. But they do. Every now and then they'll come out with a group of numbers of different bands, you know, like they did with this cold catch. Now they sold out all these. In fact, I can't buy any. I've been looking for some. And I certainly appreciate you giving me. By the way, where is it? Here it is. There it is right there.
